author: Rainstruck
body:
Being a pretty huge fan of CTH I was really excited to work on this map. With permission from the original starburst map makers, Mango, FrozenSolstice, and 'arry, I would like to proudly present, Starburst II for CTH.



Map name: Starburst II
Creator: RileGuy
Contributors (optional): Respignev, SirCyanide
Gamemode: CTH
Download link: https://github.com/resepignev/AviMaps/raw/master/Nut%20Mine/StartBurst2.zip
YML: http://pastebin.com/cLHmYM8A
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/lyEII
